spec_family.name: New Construction Drywall Wall Finish Coat
spec_family.description: Finish coat application (1-2 coats) for primed drywall walls in new construction. Applied over cured primer. Wall painter establishes the clean ceiling line via cut-in at the wall-to-ceiling boundary. Walls are painted AFTER ceilings in NC production. Separate from prime because finish happens after primer cures and may occur after trim install begins.

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier affects coat count, prep intensity, and inspection scrutiny
configuration_dimensions.notes: Coat count: QT2=1 coat, QT3=2 coats (1 if coverage achieved), QT4-QT5=2 coats. Sheen restricts minimum QT: flat/matte/eggshell=any QT, satin/semi-gloss=QT4+, gloss=QT5.

configuration_dimensions.description: Method of applying wall finish paint
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray+backroll is NC production standard. 18" roller per doctrine.

configuration_dimensions.description: Sheen level of the wall finish paint
configuration_dimensions.notes: Eggshell is standard for walls. Flat/matte/eggshell available at any QT. Satin/semi-gloss require QT4+. Gloss is NOT available for drywall walls.

configuration_dimensions.description: Surface texture of the drywall wall
configuration_dimensions.notes: Texture affects coverage rate and application technique

configuration_dimensions.description: Height classification affecting access and productivity
configuration_dimensions.notes: standard (<=9ft), tall (10-12ft), high (13-17ft), extreme (18ft+). Drives height modifier per Estimation_Modifiers_Doctrine.

paintable_items.name: Wall field finish coat
paintable_items.notes: Total wall area receiving finish coat(s)

paintable_items.name: Ceiling edge cut-in
paintable_items.notes: Wall painter establishes ceiling line. Critical difference from ceiling finish.

variants.notes: QT2 economy tier: single coat, minimal prep, no inspection/repair module
QT3 standard tier: two coats default (1 acceptable if coverage achieved), inspection/repair module
QT4/QT5 premium: two coats mandatory, intercoat sanding, critical inspection

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Wall-to-ceiling boundary for cut-in (wall painter establishes ceiling line)
Floor area for post-application vacuum cleanup
Floor area requiring full protection for spray methods
Perimeter floor protection area for roll method
Room count for fixture protection heuristic (avg 6 outlets/switches per room)
Linear feet of trim edges to mask before wall finish application

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Wall painter establishes ceiling line via freehand cut-in. Critical edge relationship.
Trim package complete and masked before wall finish. Wall painter cuts to tape line at baseboard top edge.
Door casing masked before wall finish. Wall painter cuts to tape line at door casing edges.
Window casing masked before wall finish. Wall painter cuts to tape line at window casing edges.
Other trim types (crown molding, chair rail, shadow boxes, etc.) when present. Masked and cut to tape line same as other trim.

valid_input_states.notes: Wall finish requires primed surface. Primer must be cured (refer to PDS for dry times).

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen configuration. Eggshell is default for walls.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Per doctrine: walls always cut into ceilings freehand, no tape or mask. Wall painter establishes ceiling line with brush cut-in.
Trim package complete and masked before wall finish. Tape line provides cut-in target.
Door casing complete and masked before wall finish.
Window casing complete and masked before wall finish.

cross_spec_coordination.description: If SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_PRIME performed comprehensive inspection/repair, wall finish inspection/repair module may be reduced to avoid double-counting.

scope_exclusions.route_to: Out of scope (texture is pre-paint trade)

rules.notes: Lower sheens hide imperfections; available at any quality tier
Satin reveals imperfections; requires enhanced prep and sanding discipline
Semi-gloss magnifies imperfections on drywall; requires meticulous workmanship

quality_sheen_rules.gloss_note: Gloss is NOT available for drywall walls. Not a real-world application.

QT3.notes: Standard residential. Default 2 coats for uniform color depth and hide. 1 coat acceptable if full coverage achieved.

QT4.notes: Premium tier. 2 coats mandatory with full sand between coats.

QT5.notes: Superior tier. 2 coats mandatory with full sand between coats and critical inspection.

coat_count_rules.important: Coat count is NOT automatically derived from quality tier. These are spec defaults only. Actual coat count comes from PaintScope specification.

doctrine_conflicts.doctrine_says: Medium texture (knockdown) = 3/4" nap; Light texture (orange peel) = 1/2" nap
doctrine_conflicts.research_says: For drywall walls with orange peel or knockdown texture, use 1/2" nap. 3/4" nap is only appropriate for very porous concrete, stomp texture, or popcorn ceilings.
doctrine_conflicts.research_source: Field contractor review (30 years experience), Review Notes 2026-02-04
doctrine_conflicts.recommendation: Update Materials_and_Consumables_Doctrine.md to clarify: 3/8" to 1/2" nap for all standard drywall textures; 3/4" nap reserved for heavy textures only.

research_corrections.title: No spot-priming NC drywall fasteners
research_corrections.impact: No spot-prime tasks needed - fasteners are mudded and not exposed

research_corrections.title: Do not specify dry times in specs
research_corrections.impact: No dry time references in materials - refer to PDS

research_corrections.title: Gloss not available for drywall walls
research_corrections.impact: Removed gloss from available sheens. Gloss on drywall is not a real-world application.

research_corrections.title: Semi-gloss gated at QT5 only
research_corrections.impact: Semi-gloss requires QT5 for drywall walls, not QT4+.

research_corrections.title: Coat count not derived from QT
research_corrections.impact: Coat count specified in PaintScope. QT provides defaults but actual coat count can differ.

research_corrections.title: Wall finish spec owns trim masking task
research_corrections.impact: When painting finish on drywall walls, trim is always masked. This spec owns that task.

uncertainties.description: Brief stated wall height modifiers should be lighter than ceiling (1.15/1.3/1.5 vs 1.30/1.50/2.00) due to no overhead fatigue. Using Modifier_Registry standard values pending doctrine update.
uncertainties.current_approach: Using Modifier_Registry values: H1=1.0, H2=1.30, H3=1.50, H4=2.00
